svg.title: GH1-E-02 Pump feeders P-201, P-531, P-541

g.text: Contacts and where they are drawn
Coils -K201, -K531, -K541 are switched by the PLC outputs from the safety rail 24V-S (E-08): an
E-stop removes 24V-S and the motors stop, stop category 0.
Running feedback = MPCB aux 13-14 in series with contactor aux 13-14 (E-07): a tripped MPCB
also removes the feedback, so the PLC raises the discrepancy alarm (A04, A43, A45).
P-541 (70 bar fog pump): the inlet pressure switch PSL-541 is in the -K541 coil circuit (E-08),
so the pump stops itself when the clean-water supply fails.
-K201 and -K541 21-22 are in the safety relay's EDM loop (E-06): a welded contactor blocks the
Check motor direction at first start (I/O checkout).
Irrigation, fertigation and climate control, 1 000 m² greenhouse
